narration.sl: Začnimo z nečim, kar lahko takoj vidiš: bogat vzorec nastane iz kratkega pravila. MDL×DCC povezuje opisovanje, raziskovanje in preverjanje; ta prizor je vizualni most med njimi.
narration.en: Start with something visible: a rich pattern can come from a short rule. MDL×DCC connects description, exploration and verification; this scene is a visual bridge between them.

narration.sl: Pri načrtovanju poti nekaj dodatnih postankov ustvari ogromno novih vrstnih redov. Tukaj je posnet rezultat enega preizkusa na iPhonu: Deep je za EU15 našel prikazano najboljšo pot v 4 ms, izčrpna potrditev je trajala približno 57 minut. To je konkreten primer, ne splošno jamstvo hitrosti.
narration.en: A few extra stops create an enormous number of route orders. This recorded iPhone EU15 example shows Deep finding the displayed best route in 4 ms, with exhaustive confirmation taking about 57 minutes. It is one measured example, not a universal speed guarantee.

narration.sl: Raziskovalni okvir postane uporabniško orodje: šahovnica združi tvojo idejo in preverljive alternative. V ogledu pokažemo vmesnik; obstoječo partijo in shranjene podatke ohranimo.
narration.en: The research framework becomes a usable tool: a chessboard joins your idea with alternatives that can be checked. This tour shows the interface while preserving the existing game and saved data.

narration.sl: Pri stiskanju je vprašanje zelo konkretno: ali lahko podatke opišemo krajše in jih nato natančno obnovimo? Laboratorij ločuje eksperimente in njihove pogoje. Rezultat posamezne zbirke velja za to zbirko, ne za vse možne datoteke.
narration.en: Compression asks a concrete question: can we describe data more briefly and then reconstruct it exactly? The laboratory separates experiments and their conditions. A dataset result applies to that dataset, not every possible file.

narration.sl: Ista ustvarjalna smer odpre tudi zgodbe. Nara in Illuminara sta ločeni pripovedni kontinuiteti: delita obraz in etično smer, ne pa sveta, spominov ali moči. Ogled pokaže, kako se raziskovanje spremeni v prizor in pripoved.
narration.en: The same curiosity opens into stories. Nara and Illuminara are separate narrative continuities: they share a face and ethical direction, but not a world, memories or powers. Research becomes scene and story.

narration.sl: Galerija pokaže še drugo razsežnost: vizualne interpretacije narave, prostora in zavesti. Slike so ustvarjalni izraz; njihova lepota sama po sebi ne potrjuje fizikalne teorije.
narration.en: The gallery opens another dimension: visual interpretations of nature, space and consciousness. These are creative works; their beauty does not by itself verify a physical theory.

narration.sl: Zdaj prestopimo iz programske opreme v napravo. DGTE raziskuje kapsulni termodinamični cikel. Pokažemo pot in delovanje, meritve ter gradnja pa morajo še odločiti, kaj lahko naprava doseže. Nove sheme bova kasneje vključila v isti prizor.
narration.en: Now move from software into a physical device. DGTE explores a capsule thermodynamic cycle. We show its path and operation; construction and measurement must still establish what the device can achieve. Future diagrams can replace this scene without changing the tour.

narration.sl: AI8 je arhitektura kontinuitete in vodenja raziskovanja čez modele, orodja in projekte. Namen je ohraniti seme, povezati ideje, izvesti test in zadržati rezultat s poreklom. Stran loči arhitekturo, izvedbo in dokaze; to ni dokaz dosežene AGI ali zavesti.
narration.en: AI8 is an architecture for continuity and research governance across models, tools and projects. Preserve the seed, connect ideas, run a test and retain the result with provenance. The page separates architecture, implementation and evidence; it is not proof of achieved AGI or consciousness.

narration.sl: Najširša vprašanja segajo do prostora, časa, informacije in zavesti. Predstavitev loči matematično strukturo, fizikalno hipotezo in širšo interpretacijo. Vrednost je v jasnem mostu do testa in v tem, da rezultat lahko spremeni sklep.
narration.en: The broadest questions reach space, time, information and consciousness. The presentation separates mathematical structure, physical hypothesis and broader interpretation. The useful bridge is a clear test whose outcome can change the conclusion.

narration.sl: To je bil samo prvi prelet. Za vsakim prizorom so dodatni projekti, zapisi, poskusi in odprta vprašanja. Nadaljuješ lahko z glance it, glance devices, glance creative, glance ai8 ali glance theories.
narration.en: That was only the first pass. Behind each scene are more projects, records, experiments and open questions. Continue with glance it, glance devices, glance creative, glance ai8 or glance theories.

narration.sl: 8Z Shield pokaže še praktičen programski izdelek za zaščito vsebine. V ogledu ostanemo pri javni predstavitvi; ne vnašamo gesel, zasebnih dokumentov ali prijavnih podatkov.
narration.en: 8Z Shield adds a practical software tool for protecting content. The tour stays on the public presentation, without entering passwords, private documents or login information.

narration.sl: Tu je raziskovalna sled optimizacije poti: metode, shranjeni rezultati in primerjave. Številke beremo z datumom in pogoji njihovega vira; ta arhivski prikaz ni nov današnji zagon niti dokaz splošne optimalnosti metode.
narration.en: This is the research trail behind route optimization: methods, saved results and comparisons. Read numbers with their source date and conditions; an archived display is neither a new run today nor proof of general method optimality.

narration.sl: HTH raziskuje vodno-zračni sistem in njegovo energijsko bilanco. Pri napravi odločajo izmerjeni tlak, pretok, izgube in neto izkoristek. Sedanja stran je podlaga za poznejšo jasnejšo shemo in fizični preizkus.
narration.en: HTH explores a water-and-air system and its energy balance. Measured pressure, flow, losses and net efficiency decide the device result. The current page is the starting point for a clearer future diagram and physical test.

narration.sl: SORA razširi pogled na velik orbitalni inženirski koncept. Prikazujemo zamisel, njene odvisnosti in odprta vprašanja. Nova skica bo kasneje pomagala razložiti geometrijo; trenutno je ne predstavljamo kot že izdelano ali potrjeno napravo.
narration.en: SORA expands the view to a large orbital engineering concept. We show the idea, dependencies and open questions. A future sketch will clarify its geometry; this is not an already built or verified device.

narration.sl: Illuminara dobi vizualni svet skozi javno serijo tridesetih podob. Izberemo en obstoječ prizor in njegovo kompozicijo, brez novih plačljivih generacij. Podobi in pripovedi ohranimo njuno avtorstvo in kontekst.
narration.en: Illuminara gains a visual world through a public series of thirty artworks. Show an existing scene and its composition without triggering new paid generation. Preserve the work’s credits and narrative context.

narration.sl: Ustvarjalni del ima tudi zvok: zvočne raziskave in glasbo z navedbo sodelavcev. Stran najprej pokažemo brez samodejnega predvajanja. Zvok vključimo šele na tvojo izrecno željo.
narration.en: The creative branch also has sound: audio research and music with contributor credits. Show the page without autoplay. Play audio only when explicitly requested.

narration.sl: Someone je resnična skupina in album iz leta 1994. BD je prispeval bas in grafično podobo; ohranimo tudi prispevke drugih avtorjev. Ta glasba ni predstavljena kot stvaritev umetne inteligence.
narration.en: Someone is a real band and a 1994 album. BD contributed bass and graphic artwork; preserve the other contributors’ credits too. This music is not presented as AI-generated.

narration.sl: AIM³ pokaže operativno stran sodelovanja: navodila, postopke, predaje in ohranjanje rezultatov. Kratek ukaz glance je majhen primer iste ideje: pripravljeni scenarij omogoči nadaljevanje brez ponovnega razlaganja celotnega projekta.
narration.en: AIM³ shows the operational side of collaboration: instructions, procedures, handoffs and retained results. The short glance command is a small example: a prepared scenario enables continuation without explaining the whole project again.

narration.sl: ArenaLoop je izvedbena raziskovalna smer AI8. Smiselno je ločiti zgrajene sestavne dele, njihove preizkuse in še odprte stopnje. Prikaz trenutne strani ima prednost pred starim povzetkom.
narration.en: ArenaLoop is an implementation research direction for AI8. Separate built components, their tests and still-open stages. The current visible page takes precedence over an old summary.

narration.sl: CCH predstavi predlagani fizikalni most pri raziskovanju zavesti. Razlago ohranimo kot hipotezo s predpostavkami in mogočimi testi; niti zanimivost niti medsebojno soglasje modelov ne nadomestita empiričnega dokaza.
narration.en: CCH presents a proposed physical bridge in consciousness research. Keep it a hypothesis with assumptions and possible tests; interest or agreement among models cannot replace empirical evidence.

cfh.title: Polje kot možnost, ne potrjeno dejstvo

narration.sl: CFH raziskuje širšo hipotezo polja. Oglejmo si, kaj predlaga, kaj iz tega sledi in kaj bi jo lahko preverilo ali ovrglo. Predstavitev ohrani razliko med zamislijo, matematičnim opisom in potrjeno fiziko.
narration.en: CFH explores a broader field hypothesis. Ask what it proposes, what follows and what could test or falsify it. Preserve the distinction between an idea, a mathematical description and verified physics.
